canonical_factor_registry.definition: Simple 1-year point-in-time gross NAV return prior to anchor date.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures recent historical performance and capital growth momentum.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires >= 1Y NAV history prior to T
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Overlaps with 3Y/5Y returns and Sharpe ratio
canonical_factor_registry.potential_circularity: Included 50% in production Fund Quality Score v1.0
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Subject to market regime shifts and mean reversion

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Annualized standard deviation of daily log/simple NAV returns over trailing 250 observations.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Quantifies total return variability and historical dispersion.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires >= 20 daily NAV observations in trailing year
canonical_factor_registry.potential_circularity: Included 50% (reciprocal) in production Fund Quality Score v1.0
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Treats upside and downside volatility equally

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Annualized root-mean-square of negative daily returns relative to Minimum Acceptable Return (MAR = 0%).
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures harmful downside volatility without penalizing positive upside returns.
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: High correlation with total volatility (Spearman rho > 0.95)
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Mathematically redundant with total volatility across equity funds
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Out-of-sample incremental R2 validation beyond production v1.0

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Peak-to-trough decline over historical observation window.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures maximum historical loss severity experienced from a peak.
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Overlaps with Downside Deviation and Volatility
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Multi-year rolling out-of-sample drawdown protection audit

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Time elapsed since scheme inception or available point-in-time observation history.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Differentiates established funds with deep track records from unproven funds.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires scheme creation / first NAV date
canonical_factor_registry.source_requirement: AMFI Scheme Master / Database NAV Min Date
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Measures evidence depth, NOT intrinsic return quality
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Length of historical track record available
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Older funds are NOT inherently higher return funds
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: None — correctly placed in Confidence layer

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Identifies current fund manager(s) and length of continuous tenure on the scheme.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Assesses management continuity and whether historical performance is attributable to current manager.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires historical manager assignment history table
canonical_factor_registry.source_requirement: AMC Factsheets / SEBI Filings / AMFI Disclosures
canonical_factor_registry.source_authority: AMC Monthly Factsheets & SEBI Regulatory Filings
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Overlaps with performance track record period
canonical_factor_registry.confidence_implications: Modifies confidence in historical performance relevance
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Current manager name and years managing this fund
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Historical point-in-time manager tenure table does not exist in current DB
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Data discovery & historical manager tenure database ingestion

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Annual recurring fee percentage charged by AMC for scheme management.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Higher expense ratios reduce net returns earned by investors.
canonical_factor_registry.source_requirement: AMFI Monthly TER Disclosures / AMC Mandatory Filings
canonical_factor_registry.calculation_method: Effective TER % at Anchor Date T
canonical_factor_registry.normalization_requirement: Category-Relative TER Z-Score or Direct Net Deduction
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Reflected in net NAV returns, but TER indicates fee drag
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Annual fee percentage deducted from fund assets
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Belongs in Economic Benefit / Net Fee Layer, NOT intrinsic Fund Quality score
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Historical TER backfill ingestion and net return impact validation

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Ratio of excess return over risk-free rate to total return volatility.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures return generated per unit of total risk taken.
canonical_factor_registry.source_requirement: Calculated from NAV records + RBI Repo Rate
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Combination of trailing return and volatility (already in Model 2)
canonical_factor_registry.potential_circularity: Mathematical combination of existing FQ components
canonical_factor_registry.confidence_implications: Same as underlying return and vol
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Return earned per unit of total risk
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Penalizes upside volatility; sensitive to risk-free rate assumption
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Out-of-sample incremental R2 test vs raw return + vol

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Ratio of excess return over risk-free rate to downside deviation (MAR = 0%).
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures return generated per unit of harmful downside risk taken.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires trailing return and downside deviation
canonical_factor_registry.source_requirement: Calculated from NAV records + RBI Repo Rate
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Combination of trailing return and downside deviation
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Return earned per unit of downside risk
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Requires strict adherence to governed MAR = 0% rule
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Out-of-sample predictive power comparison vs Sharpe

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Excess return generated relative to designated subcategory benchmark index.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures manager value-add beyond passive market benchmark performance.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires point-in-time benchmark mapping and TRI benchmark NAV series
canonical_factor_registry.source_requirement: NSE / BSE Index Feeds + SEBI Categorization Benchmark Mapping
canonical_factor_registry.source_authority: NSE Indices / BSE Official Benchmark Archive
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Historical benchmark NAV series and point-in-time benchmark mapping table not in DB
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Benchmark NAV ingestion & point-in-time TRI benchmark mapping governance

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Annualized standard deviation of daily return differences between scheme and benchmark.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures consistency of benchmark replication (index funds) or active risk magnitude (active funds).
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires aligned scheme and benchmark daily NAV series
canonical_factor_registry.source_authority: NSE Indices / BSE Official Benchmark Archive
canonical_factor_registry.normalization_requirement: Inverted for index funds; Z-score for active funds
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Belongs in Suitability (Index Fund Mandate Check), NOT intrinsic Fund Quality score
canonical_factor_registry.required_future_validation: Index fund tracking error database integration

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Ratio of benchmark excess return to tracking error.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Measures active return generated per unit of active benchmark risk taken.
canonical_factor_registry.historical_availability_requirement: Requires benchmark excess return and tracking error
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: Combination of excess return and tracking error
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Outperformance generated per unit of active risk

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Percentage of 1Y rolling windows where scheme generated positive returns or beat category average.
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Evaluates return consistency across multiple market mini-cycles.
canonical_factor_registry.potential_redundancy: High overlap with trailing return and volatility
canonical_factor_registry.explainability_requirements: Percentage of historical 1-year periods with positive returns
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Requires deep historical NAV backfill (>= 3 years prior to anchor)

canonical_factor_registry.definition: Regulatory risk level assigned to scheme by AMC/SEBI (Low, Moderate, High, Very High).
canonical_factor_registry.financial_rationale: Indicates regulatory risk classification for investor suitability matching.
canonical_factor_registry.known_limitations: Belongs in SUITABILITY (Risk Tolerance Match), NOT intrinsic Fund Quality score

q7_redundant_overlapping_factors: Rolling Return Consistency (overlaps with TR + Vol)
q12_factors_belonging_elsewhere: Tracking Error -> SUITABILITY (Index Fund Mandate Check) layer
required_answers.q13_factors_must_not_enter_production: ALL candidate factors outside production v1.0 (Trailing 1Y Return + Annualized Volatility) remain strictly locked in RESEARCH status until out-of-sample governance approval.
